mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Buyer-warning thread: a user says King main thrust bearings made since 2024 (also sold as Engine Tech 7.3 IDI bearings) were out of spec on free spread and an engine tech advised returning them; the poster concedes many people may have used them without problems.
mentions.replyNote: Read successfully (HTTP 200): 10 posts, still no King or official reply, no lock or resolved notice, newest post unchanged at 3 Jun 2026.

mentions.title: vg30 premature bearing failure help
mentions.snippet: Single builder reports King XP M4104STDX main bearings 2 and 3 failed on the cap side in a Nissan VG30DETT; cause (install, lubrication, or part) not established, and the poster says King has been contacted and is awaiting a reply.
mentions.replyNote: First reply check, read successfully (HTTP 200): 4 posts, none from King or an official rep, original poster says King has been contacted and is awaiting reply; thread open, no post dates visible.

mentions.title: Just call it what it is: King bearings are no longer an option
mentions.snippet: Thread argues King's 6-bolt DSM bearings are effectively discontinued; another member counters that production is irregular rather than dropped. An availability complaint, not a quality one.
